comparison.objective: Guide flexible filament into a tight feeder inlet on a 3D printer and release it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual flexible-line straightening and tight-clearance insertion while avoiding kinks.
comparison.success_condition: Filament inserted at least 20 mm, released and still, with kink, spool loss, or falling causing zero.
comparison.reason: It tests deformable insertion, not rigid concentric countertorque and functional cycling.
